description: Cryptographically verify the Ed25519 signature on a stored receipt to confirm it has not been changed since signing. Receipt format v2 signs every field (summary, cost, model, metadata, files and the chain link); legacy v1 receipts sign 12 core fields only. Returns verified, sig_version and covers_all_fields. To check a whole chain for edited, removed or forked receipts, use the CLI: agent-receipts verify-chain <chain_id>. Use to audit receipts before using them as evidence or before completing payments based on agent work.

receipt_id.description: The receipt ID to verify — must exist in local storage

name: verify_receipt
